parts.visual:
For startups and highly unprofitable growth companies, cash is oxygen. If you run out of cash, the company dies instantly.

The Two Metrics of Survival:
1. Burn Rate: The exact amount of money the company loses every single month (Expenses minus Revenue).
2. Runway: How many months the company has left before the bank account hits exactly $0.00.

Runway = Total Cash in Bank / Monthly Burn Rate.
parts.audio: For a startup, cash is oxygen. Burn Rate is how much money you lose every month. Runway is how many months you have left before the company dies.

questions.question: Your startup has $10 Million in the bank. You spend $1.5 Million a month on salaries, and you make $500,000 a month in revenue. What is your 'Burn Rate'?
options: $1 Million per month ($1.5M expenses minus $500k revenue).
questions.correct_answer: $1 Million per month ($1.5M expenses minus $500k revenue).
questions.explanation: Burn rate is net cash lost. It measures how fast the fire is consuming your resources.

questions.question: Listen to the CEO. What is the fundamental crisis?
questions.tts_text: We have three months of runway left. The venture capitalists have stopped returning my calls. We need to cut the burn rate in half immediately.
options: They are making too much money.
They are about to go bankrupt. To extend their 'Runway', they must execute massive layoffs to lower their 'Burn Rate'.
They need to hire more people.
questions.correct_answer: They are about to go bankrupt. To extend their 'Runway', they must execute massive layoffs to lower their 'Burn Rate'.
questions.explanation: If you cannot raise more cash, the only way to survive is to drastically cut expenses.

questions.question: When an investor asks a CEO 'When is your Default Alive date?', what do they mean?
options: At your current growth rate, in what exact month will your revenue finally surpass your expenses, meaning you no longer need investor money to survive?
When will you sell the company?
questions.correct_answer: At your current growth rate, in what exact month will your revenue finally surpass your expenses, meaning you no longer need investor money to survive?
questions.explanation: 'Default Alive' is the holy grail. It means you control your own destiny. 'Default Dead' means if you don't raise more money, you die.

questions.question: Why is having a high 'Burn Rate' sometimes considered a good thing in Silicon Valley?
options: Because if you are aggressively spending money on marketing to capture a massive market monopoly before your competitors, 'burning' cash is the only way to grow fast enough.
questions.correct_answer: Because if you are aggressively spending money on marketing to capture a massive market monopoly before your competitors, 'burning' cash is the only way to grow fast enough.
questions.explanation: This was the model of Uber and Amazon. Burn billions to crush the competition, then raise prices once you have a monopoly.

pairs.match: The rate at which a new company uses up its venture capital to finance overhead before generating positive cash flow
The amount of time a company has before it runs out of cash
On track to reach profitability before running out of cash
On track to run out of cash before reaching profitability
